fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without a disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior or Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale.
Where the addendum and later property-page status describe different stages, the auction-day withdrawal and any later post-auction sale are both preserved.
Addendum corrections override catalogue particulars for rent, area, lease dates, tenant identity, completion and title scope.
Seller allowances, rent deposits, temporary payments and gross/net income are kept distinct from passing rent.
Future indexed or fixed rent changes, outstanding rent reviews and options are not treated as current completed facts.
Planning, conversion, redevelopment, overage and asset-management potential remain subject to consents and legal conditions.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current company-registry status.
